sql: SELECT t1.narrative, t3.narrative, t4.narrative, t2.given, t2.surname FROM therapy_schedule AS t1 INNER JOIN subjects AS t2 ON t1.person = t2.person INNER JOIN operations AS t3 ON t2.person = t3.person INNER JOIN drugs AS t4 ON t2.person = t4.person WHERE t1.visit = '6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(t2.day)-julianday(t1.natal_day))/365) BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(t2.day)-julianday(t1.natal_day))/365) BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN t2.person END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(t2.day)-julianday(t1.natal_day))/365) BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((julianday(t2.day)-julianday(t1.natal_day))/365) BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN t2.person END) FROM subjects t1 JOIN readings t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.narrative='Glucose'
SELECT DISTINCT d.narrative FROM diagnoses d JOIN subjects s ON d.person=s.person WHERE s.title='Mrs.' AND s.given='Joye' AND s.surname='Homenick' AND substr(d.onset,1,4)='2017'

SELECT MAX(sh.day) FROM shots sh JOIN subjects s ON sh.person=s.person WHERE s.title='Mrs.' AND s.given='Joye' AND s.surname='Homenick' AND sh.narrative='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.person), t2.narrative FROM visits t1 JOIN therapy_schedule t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.cause_narrative='Second degree burn'
SELECT DISTINCT d.narrative FROM drugs d JOIN subjects s ON d.person=s.person WHERE s.given='Joye' AND s.surname='Homenick'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t1.expiry_day IS NULL THEN (julianday(substr(datetime('now'),1,10)) - julianday(t1.natal_day))/365 ELSE (julianday(t1.expiry_day) - julianday(t1.natal_day))/365 END) FROM subjects t1 JOIN diagnoses t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.sex='M' AND t2.narrative='Hypertension'
